headline: FutureTools submitted (free). The big AI directories now charge, and GitHub PRs need your login. Two decisions below unblock the rest.
north_star: First $1k MRR. Fastest path: $29 one-time pack + $19 Solo, funneled from free tools, marketed to AI-native users.

needs_owner.title: Log into GitHub in Chrome so the agent can open free awesome-list PRs
needs_owner.why: GitHub awesome-list PRs are free, high-quality backlinks to AI-native audiences. The agent can fill and open them in your browser, but you are not logged into GitHub in Chrome (and there is no gh CLI / token).
needs_owner.value: Just sign in at github.com in the same Chrome profile, then tell the agent to continue.

needs_owner.title: Reddit / Show HN / Indie Hackers posts (need your accounts + CAPTCHAs)
needs_owner.why: Highest-intent AI-native distribution. Copy is drafted; the agent can drive the forms once you are logged in and can clear CAPTCHAs.
needs_owner.where: r/SideProject, r/AI_Agents, r/SaaS, Show HN, Indie Hackers, @trispur brand accounts

spend_requests.title: Futurepedia listing - $497 one-time (free tier sold out)
spend_requests.why: Futurepedia reaches ~400k proactive professionals/mo. Only paid listings remain ($497 Verified; $247 Basic is sold out). Real paid-distribution decision - your call.

spend_requests.title: There's An AI For That - paid launch (you're already logged in)
spend_requests.why: Largest AI-native audience (~4-5M visitors/mo). Now pay-to-launch only. Price unconfirmed (a few hundred, with a $300 credit offer). Your call whether the reach is worth it.
